E0507

Collection changed while `for` reads it

What

Collection changed while `for` reads it

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0507

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0507: tests/ui/lambda_map_mutate_list.stderr.

Error [E0507]: while the loop is reading `nums`, nothing may change it
  --> tests/ui/lambda_map_mutate_list.jet:5:13
    |
  5 |             nums.push(0)
    |             ^^^^
 Why: a `loop` borrows the whole collection until the body finishes
 Fix: collect changes into a second list, or loop over indices: `loop i in 0..nums.len()-1 { }`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0507

Error [E0204]: `nums` is already shared in this call, so it can't be changed here too
  --> tests/ui/lambda_map_mutate_list.jet:5:13
    |
  5 |             nums.push(0)
    |             ^^^^
 Why: while something is being looked at, nobody else may be changing it
 Fix: drop the extra use of `nums`, or copy first with `~nums`
